declaration.preface:
Embodying a steadfast commitment to principles of transparency, integrity, and responsible business practices, we at Exim Knits Pvt Ltd. believe that Ethical Governance Policy, is a cornerstone in our mission to redefine the standards of excellence. Ethical conduct is not just an obligation but a guiding philosophy

Our Ethical Governance Policy stands as a declaration to our responsibility towards a spectrum of stakeholders, including employees, customers, investors, and the communities we touch. It goes beyond regulatory compliance, serving as a blueprint for a corporate culture built on trust, accountability, and ethical decision-making. At Exim Knits Pvt Ltd, we view ethical governance as not only a foundation for sustainable growth but as an intrinsic value that permeates every facet of our operations.

This dynamic policy is not static; but it evolves with the changing landscape of ethical standards and company’s best practices. We believe that ethical governance is not just an expectation but a shared commitment and we weave the fabric characterized by ethical excellence, ensuring that our business practices reflect our dedication to a sustainable, responsible, and prosperous future for all.
declaration.declaration: Exim Knits Pvt Ltd. is committed for upholding the highest standards of corporate responsibility, and we pledge to foster an environment of trust, accountability, and ethical conduct. Our aim is to set a benchmark for ethical governance within the textile industry, ensuring sustainable practices that benefit our stakeholders and contribute to a responsible and prosperous future.
declaration.scope: This Policy is applicable to following sites and all of its employees, workers, sub-contractors and other stakeholders:

Corruption: Procurement and Contracts: Implement transparent procurement processes, conduct regular audits, and enforce a strict anti-bribery policy.
Supply Chain Management: Ensure supply chain transparency, conduct thorough supplier audits, and establish ethical sourcing guidelines..
Fraudulent Practices: Strengthen internal controls, and encourage whistleblowing. Adopt technologies such as blockchain to enhance transparency in financial transactions and supply chains.
Conflict of Interest: Supplier and Vendor Relationships: Implement guidelines for selecting and engaging with suppliers, emphasizing fairness and impartiality.
Regular Training and Communication: Conduct regular training sessions and communication campaigns to keep employees aware of ethical governance principles and their importance.
Decision-Making Processes: Implement robust decision-making protocols, emphasizing fair and impartial evaluation criteria.
Fraud: Raw Material Misrepresentation: Implement strict supplier vetting processes, conduct random material testing, and establish transparent supply chain tracking.

Counterfeit Products: Employ advanced anti-counterfeiting technologies like RFID tags, holograms, or blockchain for product traceability. Regular market surveillance and legal actions against counterfeiters are also crucial.

Invoice Fraud: Implement robust financial controls, conduct regular audits, and utilize technology such as blockchain or secure payment systems to ensure the integrity of financial transactions and invoices.
Money Laundering: Trade-Based Money Laundering: Implement advanced trade finance technologies, conduct thorough due diligence on trading partners, and utilize blockchain for transparent and traceable transactions.

Supply Chain Manipulation: Establish a transparent and auditable supply chain, conduct regular due diligence on suppliers, and collaborate with industry peers to share information on potential risks and suspicious activities.
Anti-competitive practice: Promotion of Fair Competition: Avoid engaging in anticompetitive practices such as price fixing, bid rigging, or exclusive dealing. Encourage ethical business conduct, establish transparent procurement processes, and support initiatives that foster a competitive marketplace.

Customer-Centric Innovation: Invest in research and development, prioritize customer needs, and avoid practices that stifle innovation or create entry barriers. Engage with customers to understand their preferences and continually adapt to market dynamics.
Information Security: Protecting Sensitive Data: The textile industry handles sensitive information such as designs, supply chain details, and customer data. Ensuring information security is crucial to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, and intellectual property theft.

Maintaining Customer Trust: Information security measures help build and maintain trust with customers. Ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of customer data demonstrates a commitment to protecting their sensitive information.

policy.monitoring:
In our dedication to transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement, Exim Knits Pvt Ltd. has established a dynamic framework for timely policy updates. The records of following elements are maintained within each deal and contract with our material supplier related to the financing of product shipments. These include:

Payments in a currency different from the contract specification.

Payments to countries not related to the contractual agreement.

Cash payments.

Payments to individuals or entities not explicitly included in the agreement.

Any other unusual or unconventional payment requests.

A detailed report outlining the frequency of such activities is meticulously prepared, submitted, and subsequently shared with stakeholders and company executives.

Continuous improvement in ethical governance is not only a commitment but a journey towards excellence. By embracing a culture of constant refinement and responsiveness, we aim to set new benchmarks in ethical conduct within our company, fostering trust, sustainability, and long-term success for all stakeholders.

Audits for Enhancement: Conduct regular internal audits for policy effectiveness and implement targeted improvements aligning with evolving standards.

Stakeholder Engagement: Establish an open channel for stakeholder feedback and actively seek input for refinement and addressing ethical concerns.

Benchmarking Excellence: Regularly benchmark policies against industry standards. and collaborate with peers, engage in initiatives, and adopt emerging frameworks.
policy.reviewMechanism: This policy will be reviewed every year to track the progress on every issue and its targets.
